findings.disposition: Root requires recheck of held recorder and gate hashes within each post-command state block, recording failure before stopping.
findings.finding: Recorder and gate hashes are checked before each run but not after the final run; state() rechecks tracked/remote/guard state only. Mutation during run2 can leave successful completion despite changed recorder or gate bytes.

findings.disposition: Root chose trusted-source projection rather than independent classifier. Rename public_report_complete_and_valid to public_report_canonical_and_closed and document identity/shape/disclosure limits; retain all existing checks. Actual-result review must assess observed category/stage/path consistency. Do not duplicate classifier or rerun private source.
findings.finding: Category/stage/scope enums and exposure shapes are closed, but cross-field semantic consistency is not independently checked. A canonical correctly identified report with primary MEMBER_FLAGS, stage complete, compatible_reason ZIP_LIMIT and directory/close flags false can satisfy current membership checks. This counterexample was inferred from source, not executed.
